payload.payload: C4.2 PR comment wiring: action.yml +91 (3 post-steps: Capture ledger summary via polyforge-cli ledger summary -> $GITHUB_OUTPUT; Parse gate manifest facts passed/tail_hash/bundle_sha256 from ${{inputs.evidence-dir}}/gate-${{inputs.task-id}}.manifest.json with trailing-slash strip; Post gate summary PR comment via actions/github-script@v7 createComment). Body = summary line (tasks_verified/validated/failed) + passed/tail_hash/bundle_sha256 only, no secrets, no full ledger. ci.yml +3: job permissions contents:read + pull-requests:write. New test .github/actions/polyforge/tests/comment-script.test.js (94L, vm sandbox, happy path 1 comment + fail-closed path). Verified: node test all assertions passed, YAML parses OK, node --check wrapped IIFE rc 0, live smoke summary tasks_verified=24 tasks_validated=0 tasks_failed=0 + manifest facts byte-identical to gate-p0-c4-1.manifest.json.
